texts.zh: 你好！我们种群自到来后数量上已经翻了四翻，你知道了一定很高兴！刚到达星球时，大家都欢欣雀跃，如今甚至有点狂欢的势头。顺利殖民伯达拉克之后，一些勇敢的拓荒者想前往另一个巨型气态行星，他们让我求求你看看行不行。我们已经看中了一个有前途的候选行星，很适合殖民；而且它就在你们管辖的领域之内。你怎么看，朋友？
texts.en:
Hello again! You will be pleased to learn that our species has quadrupled in number since we arrived! Many of us were swept up in a festive mood when we made planetfall, and things got a bit frisky to say the least.

After the positive experience we had colonizing Baldarak, a few brave pioneers have asked me to petition you for passage to another gas giant. We have already located a promising candidate within your space that would be suitable for colonization. What do you say, friends?

label.zh: 反正还是个气态巨行星，那就……
label.en: Well, as long as it's just another gas giant...

responses.zh: 太好了！我们会把坐标发送给你。我们的殖民者迫不及待了！
responses.en: Marvelous! We are forwarding you the coordinates. Our colonists are eager to get underway!

label.zh: 绝对不行。我们说的是只把你送上一颗行星。
label.en: Absolutely not. Our deal was to transport you to ONE planet.

responses.zh: 我懂了……那我们就好好留在伯达拉克，充分利用这里的条件。
responses.en: I... see. We will just have to stay contained on Baldarak and make the best of it then.

notes.zh: 审阅注：本故事承接“气态巨行星信号”（anomaly-signal-gasgiant-category，c3a）：其5006“移居”选项设旗标baldarak_settled，之后本事件以平均240个月的随机间隔触发（events/anomaly_events_4.txt:265-285）。
notes.en: Review note: this story continues "Gas Giant Signal" (anomaly-signal-gasgiant-category, c3a): its 5006 relocation sets baldarak_settled and this event then fires after an average of 240 months (events/anomaly_events_4.txt:265-285).

texts.zh: 达斯纳克想在[NewBaldarak.GetName]这一气态巨行星上建立一个新的殖民地，那里的大气层很适合他们生存。我们已同意帮助他们。
texts.en: The Dathnak would like to found a new colony on [NewBaldarak.GetName], a gas giant with an atmosphere suitable to their physiology. We have agreed to assist them in this endeavor.

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

texts.zh: 与之前相同，在这个高压的气态行星内，一队货船被用来安全运输达斯纳克殖民者。不久之后，他们成功着陆，并将这里命名为“新伯达拉克”。轨道上留了一颗人造卫星，用于和伯达拉克之间进行远距离通讯。
texts.en: As before, a convoy of freighters was assembled to safely transport the Dathnak colonists inside pressurized gas tanks. After a brief journey, they successfully made planetfall on the gas giant which they have named "New Baldarak." A satellite was left in orbit to allow for long-range communication with Baldarak.

label.en: Make the most of it, Dathnak.

label.zh: 约220个月后（需已定居新殖民地）
label.en: ~220 months later (needs the new colony settled)
~320 months later (while contact is not lost)
~320 months later (while contact is not lost)

texts.zh: 新伯达拉克向你问好！这边新殖民地一切顺利，不过我们又一个小请求……我们的一位殖民者，查比克·莱迪，十分想念伯达拉克上的家人和朋友，想要回家。她的絮絮叨叨快把我们逼疯了！如果不麻烦的话，你可以来带她回去吗？
texts.en:
Greetings from New Baldarak! Things are progressing well here at our new colony. However, we have a small request...

Chabky Raddh, one of our colonists, misses her family and friends on Baldarak terribly and wants to go home. Her whining is driving us crazy! If it's not too much to ask, do you think you could take her back?

responses.zh: 我们还是得问问……请不要介意。查比克会尽全力在这里生活的，就像我们其他人一样！抱歉浪费了你的时间，[Root.GetSpeciesName]朋友。
responses.en: We had to try... I hope you don't mind. Chabky will just have to settle down and make the best of the situation, like the rest of us! Sorry for wasting your time, [Root.GetSpeciesName] friends.

responses.zh: 太好了。希望不会太浪费你的资源，因为只是来接一个人。我们这边会安排好的。我刚和查比克说了，她高兴得在原地转圈！她好像有点高兴得失去控制了……失陪了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]朋友……
responses.en:
Excellent. Hopefully this won't put too much of a strain on your resources, since you'll only be transporting a single individual. We'll make the necessary arrangements on our end.

I just broke the news to Chabky, and she is spinning with joy! In fact, she is spinning out of control now... you'll have to excuse me, [Root.GetSpeciesName] friends...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 达斯纳克殖民者查比克·莱迪思念自己的家乡，希望能够回到伯达拉克。我们勉强答应了这个要求。
texts.en: The Dathnak colonist Chabky Raddh is apparently homesick and wishes to return to Baldarak. We have reluctantly agreed to arrange this.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的护送下，一艘带着气体滤毒罐的小飞船来到伯达拉克。滤毒罐内的气体排放到气态行星的大气内，送这位达斯纳克殖民者安全回家。
texts.en: A single cargo tug hauling a gas canister has arrived at Baldarak under escort by the [Root.GetName]. The contents of the canister have been released into the gas giant's atmosphere, safely returning the Dathnak colonist to her home.

label.zh: 约120个月后（切布基已送回）

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的舰队名称。
note.en: In the game, your fleet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们收到了令人不安的消息，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]朋友！我们失去了与新伯达拉克的联络！他们不再回应我们卫星发射的信号，恐怕要做最坏的打算。也许入侵我们母星的外星人又回来了。请派飞船调查！
texts.en:
We bring alarming news, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] friends!

Contact with our colony on New Baldarak has been lost! They no longer respond to any of our satellite transmissions, and we fear the worst. Perhaps the aliens who bombarded our original homeworld have returned to finish the job. Please send a ship to investigate!

label.en: We shall dispatch a ship at once.

responses.zh: 太好了！希望仅仅是发射器故障而已。
responses.en: Excellent! Hopefully it's just a faulty transmitter.

label.zh: 够了！我们不是给你跑腿的。
label.en: Enough! We are not your errand boys.

responses.zh: 但、但他们可能都死了！你就这么铁石心肠吗？我们看错你了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]！
responses.en: But... but they could all be dead! Are you truly so callous? We misjudged you, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 在伯达拉克的达斯纳克政府与他们在新伯达拉克的殖民地失去了联系，他们担心出现最坏的结果。我们已经同意调查这个星球。
texts.en: The Dathnak authorities on Baldarak have lost contact with their colony on New Baldarak, and they fear the worst. We have agreed to investigate the planet.

texts.zh: 我们并没有查出新伯达拉克有什么异常。用于与首都通讯的人造卫星在正常运转。
texts.en: Our investigation of New Baldarak has revealed nothing out of the ordinary. The satellite the colony used to communicate with their capital is still functional as far as we can tell.

label.zh: 向行星开通一条通讯频道。
label.en: Open a channel to the planet.

texts.zh: 新伯达拉克革命阵线向你问好！我们打倒了伯达拉克！我们与你没有过节，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]，只要你不去支持伯达拉克统领者的反革命行为。不过你可以支持我们……你愿意把一支突击队带到伯达拉克去吗？
texts.en:
Greetings from the New Baldarak Revolutionary Front!

We have thrown off the yoke of oppression and are at last free from the tyranny of Baldarak! We have no quarrel with you, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], as long as you refrain from aiding the Baldarak imperialists in their inevitable attempt to crush our revolution.

You could help us take the fight to our enemies, however... would you be willing to deliver one of our commando units to Baldarak?

label.en: Tell us what you have planned.

responses.zh: 我们打算用一支精英突击队深入伯达拉克。他们将打破枷锁。残酷统治者被废除之后，所有达斯纳克人终将过上自在的生活。这个计划直接明了，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。
responses.en: We want to infiltrate Baldarak with one of our elite commando units. They will then incite a popular uprising against the decadent elite that lords over our people. After the tyrants have been deposed, all Dathnak will at last know what it is to have true freedom. A straightforward plan if ever there was one, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

label.zh: 我们会把你们的士兵送过去的。

responses.zh: 真的吗？！你是我们革命的好同志，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]！让我组织一下！
responses.en: Really?! You will? You are a true friend of the revolution, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]! Let me get the team together!

label.zh: 我们不干扰你们的内部纠纷。
label.en: We are not getting involved in your internal dispute.

responses.zh: 当然了！我们可不想让革命的星星之火烧到被你当做奴隶的人民群众那里去！
responses.en: Of course you're not! We wouldn't want the revolution to spread to the oppressed masses in YOUR tyrannical empire. Can't have that!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 在新伯达拉克的达斯纳克革命者希望我们能够帮助运送他们的突击部队到达伯达拉克，这样他们能够在当地煽动起义。
texts.en: The Dathnak revolutionaries on New Baldarak have asked us to transport one of their commando units to Baldarak, where they will try to incite some kind of revolt.

texts.zh: 一艘由[Root.GetName]护送的飞船悄悄将飞行舱送入伯达拉克大气，里面载着革命突击队。片刻，气态行星的云层下发出阵阵闪光。这是开始战斗了吗？
texts.en: A cargo tug escorted by the [Root.GetName] has stealthily dropped the cargo pod containing the revolutionary commando unit into Baldarak's atmosphere. Moments later, flashes can be seen coming from deep within the gas giant's cloud layer. Could it be signs of fighting?

label.en: We shall see what happens next.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的舰队名称。
note.en: In the game, your fleet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我是佛坦伽！伯达拉克的人们推翻了欺压，他们以为可以让我们种群变为奴隶。我们建立了一个革命委员会，确保我们伟大的帝国度过这段转型期，并努力解放我们的人民。我们感谢[Root.GetName]的同志，他们的帮助让今天成为现实。完毕。
texts.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The people of Baldarak have overthrown the tyrants and oppressors that sought to enslave our species under their rule. A revolutionary council has been established to see our great nation through this transitional phase, while we work diligently to restore freedom to the people.

We wish to thank our comrades in the [Root.GetName] for their assistance in making this day come true.

That is all.

label.en: Perhaps everything will work out for the best.

label.zh: 约120个月后（革命议会成立）

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现护送我们的舰队名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the escorting fleet appears here.

texts.zh: 我是佛坦伽！为了纪念我的统领，人民革命委员会一致同意，将星球名“伯达拉克”更改为“佛坦伽族”。还有，前“新伯达拉克”将更名为“查比克马克”，以我们的公众安全指挥官查比克·莱迪为名。完毕。
texts.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council has unanimously voted to rename the planet formerly known as "Baldarak" to "Fotangia" in honor of my leadership.

Also, the planet formerly known as "New Baldarak" shall henceforth be known as "Chabkymak" after Chabky Raddh, our Minister of Public Safety.

That is all.

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

texts.zh: 我是佛坦伽！人民革命委员会宣布，4539人即将因背叛和反革命被处以死刑。那些意欲阻止我们光辉革命之辈，愿此声明以儆效尤。完毕。
texts.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of 4,539 individuals convicted of state treason and counter-revolutionary activities.

Let this serve as a warning to all those who would stand in the way of our glorious revolution.

That is all.

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

texts.zh: 我是拉玛格！人民革命委员会宣布，佛坦伽即将因鼓动罪、腐朽和失职被处以死刑，即刻执行。我将接手他以前的所有职责。我的第一道法令是恢复佛坦伽族和查比克马克原来的名字。完毕。
texts.en:
This is Citizen Rutmag! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of Former Citizen Fotanga, who has been convicted of demagoguery, corruption and general incompetence.

I will be assuming all of his former duties. My first decree is that the original names of planets Fotangia and Chabkymak be restored.

That is all.

texts.zh: 我代表伯达拉克的合法达斯纳克发言。我们收到了当前掌控新伯达拉克组织的声明，一派胡言！这些土匪简直是我们的耻辱，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。能请你帮忙扑灭他们小小的“革命”吗？我担心如果事态蔓延到这里，会有人受伤。帕塔纳克将军已派出一支远征部队，意在夺回殖民地，但我们需要你帮忙将他们送到那里。
texts.en:
I speak on behalf of the lawful Dathnak government on Baldarak.

We have received a manifesto from the group that seized control of New Baldarak, and boy, what a bunch of hogwash! These brigands and anarchists are a terrible embarrassment to us, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]. Will you help us stomp out their little "revolution" before it spreads here and someone actually gets hurt?

General Paltanak has prepared an expeditionary force to retake the colony, but we'll need your help transporting it there.

responses.zh: 就知道可以指望你，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]！这些叛军要死不瞑目了！
responses.en: We knew we could count on you, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]! These rebels won't know what hit them!

label.en: You need to solve your own problems.

responses.zh: 等这场反叛蔓延到你们的殖民地上，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]，你们就要后悔了！别以为你们可以高枕无忧！
responses.en: You'll be sorry once this rebellion spreads to your colonies, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]! Don't think it won't!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 达斯纳克政府决心恢复对被叛军占领的新伯达拉克地区的控制权。我们已经同意运输他们的远征军前往那里。
texts.en: The Dathnak government on Baldarak is determined to restore control over their rebelling colony on New Baldarak. We have agreed to transport an expeditionary force to the planet.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]护送下，几艘货船将一队达斯纳克远征部队投入新伯达拉克大气层。片刻，气态行星的云层下发出阵阵闪光。战斗似乎开始了。
texts.en: Several freighters under escort by the [Root.GetName] have dropped the cargo canisters carrying the Dathnak expeditionary force into New Baldarak's atmosphere. Moments later flashes can be seen coming from beneath the gas giant's cloud layer. The fighting appears to have started.

label.en: Now we wait and see what happens next.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的舰队名称。
note.en: In the game, your fleet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，我在新伯达拉克。怒气燎原行动大获全胜。所有主要目标都已达成，所有大气区的政府都已恢复控制。除了还有几处负隅顽抗之外，多数叛军都已偃旗息鼓或阵亡。多谢你的帮助，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。请失陪，我需要向伯达拉克汇报伤亡情况。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
texts.en:
General Paltanak here, speaking from New Baldarak. Operation Gaseous Fury has been a complete success. All primary objectives have been seized, and government control has been restored to all atmospheric sectors.

Aside from a few holdouts, most rebel units have surrendered or been routed. Much obliged for the support, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If you'll excuse me, I need to transmit a casualty report to Baldarak.

Paltanak out.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种复数名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of your species appears here.

texts.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的代理军团指挥官。很高兴宣布47-G区的主要战斗已经结束。至少512名抗争者被消灭，我方伤亡极低。特别表扬将平民伤亡控制到可接受水平的部队。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
texts.en:
General Paltanak here, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I am pleased to announce the end of major combat operations in sector 47-G.  At least 512 insurgents have been confirmed killed since the operation began two cycles ago, while our own losses have been minimal.

Extra commendations to all forces involved for keeping civilian casualties at an acceptable level.

Paltanak out.

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

label.zh: 约120个月后（拒绝广播在此线上无效）
label.en: ~120 months later (blocking has no effect on this line)

texts.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。我希望澄清这个世界重现抵抗活动的谣言。这完全不是事实。本行星已经完全恢复和平，所有潜在不安定因素已经彻底根除。其人民已再次回到达斯纳克帝国治下。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
texts.en:
This is General Paltanak, military governor of New Baldarak. I wish to address unsubstantiated reports claiming there has been a resurgence in rebel activity on this world. Let me tell you now that nothing could be further from the truth.

This planet has been fully pacified, and all subversive terrorist elements have been fully rooted out. Its citizens are once again productive members of the greater Dathnak nation.

Paltanak out.

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

texts.zh: 我是拉普塔兹将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。很遗憾向大家宣告我的前任，帕塔纳克将军的死亡。他被诱入叛军部队卑鄙的埋伏，光荣牺牲。我们将举行盛大的葬礼，同时庆祝当前压制叛军堡垒的胜利。拉普塔兹讲话完毕。
texts.en:
Colonel Rapzak reporting, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I must regretfully inform the galactic community of the demise of my predecessor, General Paltanak. After being lured into a dastardly ambush by rebel forces, the General gave his life in the finest tradition of the service.

A state funeral with full honors will be held at the successful conclusion of our current offensive against the rebel strongholds.

Rapzak out.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我代表伯达拉克科学院与你交流。虽然我们达斯纳克不精于技术，但我们十分擅长理性演绎！

我们气态人的数个智囊团已经花费数年研究理论物理，并想要分享成果。也许我们的数据能对你们固态人热衷的帝国建设发挥作用。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! I have been asked to approach you on behalf of the Baldarak Science Academy. Although we Dathnak don't possess much in the way of technology, we are certainly capable of higher reasoning!

A few of our think tanks have spent the last several years studying theoretical physics, and we would like to share their findings. Perhaps the data will be of some use to you in the empire building activities you solids are so fond of.

note.en: In the game, the plural name of your species appears here.

texts.zh: 你好，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！可以帮我们个忙吗？伯达拉克的强大引力把各种垃圾拉进了我们的大气，最近我们决定要进行清理。有个清理组发现了一个废弃的飞行舱，你可以帮忙处理掉它吗？它里面似乎塞满了各种没用的金属。
texts.en:
Hello, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Would you be willing to do us a favor? Baldarak's strong gravity well pulls all kinds of trash into our atmosphere, and at a recent council meeting we decided to step up our cleaning efforts. One of our reclamation units came across a discarded cargo pod, and we're wondering if you'd be willing to help us dispose of it. It seems to contain large quantities of various worthless metals.

# 新殖民地 / A New Colony

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`events/anomaly_events_4.txt` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 承接“气态巨行星信号”故事：玩家把达斯纳克（Dathnak）迁往居住后设旗标baldarak_settled(5006)，随后一连串状态触发（mean_time_to_happen）事件：5007“新殖民地”要求该旗标，平均240个月（events/anomaly_events_4.txt:265-285）。  
  Continues the "Gas Giant Signal" story: after the Dathnak are resettled (flag baldarak_settled, 5006), a chain of state-triggered events (mean_time_to_happen) follows; 5007 "A New Colony" needs that flag, mean 240 months (events/anomaly_events_4.txt:265-285).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 殖民：5007a→项目GAS_GIANT_COLONY→5008（设new_baldarak_settled）。之后三条互相独立的线：  
  Colony: 5007 a → project GAS_GIANT_COLONY → 5008 (sets new_baldarak_settled). Three independent lines then follow:
- ① 切布基·拉德：5009（~220个月）b→项目GAS_GIANT_LOST_CHABKY→5010（设chabky_raddh_done）→5011“失联”（~120个月；a→项目GAS_GIANT_LOST_CONTACT→5012“特别项目完成”→5013“革命阵线”；b不管）。  
  ① Chabky Raddh: 5009 (~220 months) b → project GAS_GIANT_LOST_CHABKY → 5010 (sets chabky_raddh_done) → 5011 "Lost Contact" (~120 months; a → project GAS_GIANT_LOST_CONTACT → 5012 → 5013 "Revolutionary Front"; b ignores it).
- ② 5013三选：a对话；b运送突击队→项目GAS_GIANT_REVOLT→5015→5016“革命议会”（35-75天，设baldarak_revolution_1）→5017→5018→5019（每约120个月，公布星球改名等）；c不介入→5014“巴尔达拉克回应”（35-75天）a→项目GAS_GIANT_OCCUPATION→5020→5021（设new_baldarak_occupation_1）→5022→5023→5024（每约120个月的占领公告）。  
  ② 5013 offers three options: a dialogue; b ferry the commandos → project GAS_GIANT_REVOLT → 5015 → 5016 "Revolutionary Council" (35-75 days, sets baldarak_revolution_1) → 5017 → 5018 → 5019 (each ~120 months: public announcements, planet renamed); c stay out → 5014 "Baldarak Responds" (35-75 days) a → project GAS_GIANT_OCCUPATION → 5020 → 5021 (sets new_baldarak_occupation_1) → 5022 → 5023 → 5024 (occupation announcements every ~120 months).
- ③ 5025“科学院”与5026“春季大扫除”：新殖民地定居后约每320个月各一次，仅在尚未失联时出现（给物理研究/矿物奖励）。  
  ③ 5025 "Baldarak Science Academy" and 5026 "Spring Cleaning": about once per 320 months each after settlement, only while contact is not lost (physics research / minerals reward).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 革命线与占领线由5013的选项互斥；革命线5017/5018中选“屏蔽”(dathnak_blocked)会终止后续公告，占领线的屏蔽选项无效。  
  The revolution and occupation lines are exclusive via 5013; choosing to block (dathnak_blocked) in 5017/5018 stops the later announcements of the revolution line, but the block option has no effect on the occupation line.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 文案随物种与是否拥有“Baldarak”物种而变。  
  Text varies with species and with owning the Baldarak species.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照events/anomaly_events_4.txt:265-1010的全部触发、旗标与项目；原先11个独立故事（5007、5009、5011、5017-5019、5022-5026）现合并为一个，加入12条带旗标/平均时间的审阅连接。  
  Checked all triggers, flags and projects in events/anomaly_events_4.txt:265-1010; the former 11 separate stories (5007, 5009, 5011, 5017-5019, 5022-5026) are merged into one with 12 reviewed flag / mean-time bridges.
- 5006（移居）属c3a的故事，未在此连接。  
  5006 (resettlement) belongs to c3a's story and is not linked here.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部25个文档。 / All 25 docs.
